svg.title: Erythrocyte
svg.desc: Anucleate red biconcave disc with a broad rim and pale central depression. Biological basis: The biconcave membrane maximizes surface-area-to-volume ratio and deformability while mature mammalian erythrocytes lack nuclei and organelles.
